name: Murray G. Goldberg
headline: Urologist, TGH Urology Group of Florida
on_the_show: Dr. Goldberg shared Episode 4 with First Rehabilitation’s Kayla Dorsey, joining the second half of the show to talk about men’s health and aging well. His message was about staying proactive with your body, and why paying attention early pays off for decades. The episode tied both guests together around one theme, taking ownership of your health.

background.text: He has practiced urology in the Palm Beach County area since 1991.

He earned his medical degree and completed his urology residency at New York University Medical Center, with rotations at Bellevue Hospital, the Manhattan VA Medical Center and Memorial Sloan Kettering.
His practice profile describes him as board certified in adult and pediatric urology.
He is one of the Palm Beach County urologists of Urology Group of Florida, which partnered with Tampa General Hospital in 2024 and is now known as TGH Urology Group of Florida.
He is a member of the American Urological Association and its Southeastern Section, the Florida Medical Association and the Palm Beach County Medical Society.
